what: A Branch Manager of another office (Mumbai) approved an Ahmedabad report (role-based step) by sending the approve action; the report page refuses him. Report became "fully approved".
rule: docs/02 B4 (report reach: issuing / executing / contracting office only); same hole as DEF-REP-015 closed for edit/fill

what: A Finalise holder of another office (Test BranchMgr2) issued an Ahmedabad report by sending the issue action; client notified. document-finalize checks no office reach.
rule: docs/02 B4 (anyone else is refused); docs/03 Inspection report (issue)

what: Any Finalise holder from any office soft-deletes an ISSUED report with no reason; the client verify page then says "We do not recognise that code". document-delete has no status, office or reason check.
rule: docs/03 Inspection report: ISSUED is locked, corrected only by a new revision; docs/02 B4 reach

what: Only one hand-raised hold/witness point can exist company-wide: the second "Raise" fails with "The app hit an error" (UNIQUE constraint on empty hw_points.dedupe_key, lib/hwpoints.php hwp_create).
rule: docs/02 ²⁰ᵇ (X1: hold & witness points work again)

what: Endorsement page, edit and endorse have no office check: an Ahmedabad Coordinator opens and edits a Mumbai endorsement by its address; an Ahmedabad Branch Manager (not assigned) endorses it.
rule: docs/02 B4 own-branch reach (register is branch-limited; page and actions are not)

what: An Inspector can change a vendor's qualification status (Prospect → Approved) on Vendor profile → Save profile (canEdit accepts mod.idems.edit).
rule: docs/02 Business Partners: INS "—"; Vendors register already refuses the Inspector

what: A Finalise holder of another office vets (clears) and forwards an Ahmedabad report by sending the vet action (ops_idems_vet has no idems_doc_access check).
rule: docs/02 B4 report reach

what: Vetting "Return for correction" moves an UNDER_REVIEW report back to Draft and deletes its approval steps (no "closed levels" History line).
rule: docs/03 Inspection report: VETTING → DRAFT only; UNDER_REVIEW → DRAFT only by approver send-back or executing-office reopen

what: Evidence review lists flagged photos of every report (any office, any inspector) and lets an inspector "Accept" (clear) another inspector's photo flag.
rule: Owner point 5 / docs/02 item 18: inspectors open only their own reports, photos and files included

what: Test Director (View) and Test BAM (config only) can clear hold/witness points (hwp_can_edit accepts mod.jobs.edit).
rule: docs/02 ²⁰ᵇ: raise / clear / waive / cancel / reopen = MA, AD, BM, OM, AM, CO, inspectors

what: Without a work order, a second report for the same client, type and date (or within 2 minutes when no date) is refused as a duplicate even with a different PO.
rule: Code rule in idems_po_locked(): "a different P.O. is fine, which is how several P.O.s for one vendor on the same day are handled"

what: New inspection report offers all 17 offices in "Office"; filing under another office uses that office's number series and the creator is then refused on the report.
rule: docs/02 B4/B5 (a report is started and opened only within the person's reach)

what: An inspector from another office allocated to a deputation sees it in My jobs, but its job page is refused, so he has no screen with "Start next stage report".
rule: docs/02 item 18 §B (a): the next inspector presses it from their job page; Jobs INS "View/Close own"

what: TB Group Parent and TB Group Child get numbers in one shared series (TBGROU …/000001, …/000002): the client part is the first 6 letters of the name when the client code is longer than 8.
rule: Owner rule: series per client and report type (pack 29 Q1 "per client and report type")

what: "Finalize & issue" is shown to the report's own approver, who is then refused (approver ≠ issuer).
rule: UI blueprint: a button does what its label says (B7-type: buttons that only lead to a refusal)

what: Fill report page shows "Submit for approval →" to the contracting office; pressing it is refused.
rule: docs/02 point 6: the contracting office "has no Submit button"

what: "📋 Draft Release Note" is shown on an approved, not issued report, where it can only be refused.
rule: UI blueprint (B7-type)

what: Serial width outside 3–10 is stored as 6 with "Numbering rules saved." (no message that the value was not used).
rule: UI blueprint: plain feedback; REP-030

what: Adjust dates still accepts an empty value and erases the issue date of an issued report (DEF-REP-013 / B1, not in batch 2).
rule: Pack 14 B1 (proposal, awaiting "B ok")

what: An empty approval-rule form is still saved as a rule (DEF-REP-014 / B11, not in batch 2).
rule: Pack 14 B11 (awaiting "B ok")

what: A temporary cover with "To" before "From" is saved (REP-033, still present).
rule: REP-033 expectation
